LESSON: INTEGRATED FARMING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Conservation of Resources
Topic 1.3: Integrated Farming

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Integrated Farming
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can integrated farming conserve resources?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Integrated Farming

Teach
• Observe Integrated Farming in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Integrated Farming (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Integrated Farming.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Integrated Farming.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Integrated Farming.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Integrated Farming.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Integrated Farming: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can integrated farming conserve resources?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
